description: One deposit destination for one employee. An employee splitting their net pay across two accounts has two rows here, each with its own allocation; the row with allocation_type Full takes whatever the fixed and percentage rows have not. The full account number is encrypted at rest and no tool reads it back — only the last four are ever displayed.

fields.description: Only Active accounts are paid. Deactivating a row is how an account is retired — the row is kept because it is the evidence of where a past payroll was sent.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The order allocations are applied in when an employee splits their pay. Lower numbers are taken first; the Full account is always taken last regardless.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Nine digits. Validated against the ABA check digit on save, which catches a mistyped digit and a transposed pair — between them almost every way a routing number is copied wrong off a cheque.
fields.label: Routing Number

fields.description: Decides the ACH transaction code: 22 for a checking credit, 32 for savings. Sending a savings account under a checking code is a returned entry.
fields.label: Account Type

fields.description: Only the last four digits. Everything that displays this account displays ****1234 off this column, and it is written from the full number on save.
fields.label: Account Number (Last 4)

fields.description: The full account number, encrypted at rest in Frappe's own password table. No tool reads it back: get_employee_bank_account does not return it and the mobile route does not either. It leaves this site in exactly one direction — into a generated ACH file, which is a private attachment.
fields.label: Account Number (Encrypted)

fields.description: Full takes the whole remaining net pay and an employee may have only one. Fixed Amount takes a set number of dollars; Percentage takes a share of gross net pay. Fixed and percentage rows are satisfied first and the Full row receives the remainder.
fields.label: Allocation Type

fields.description: Dollars when the allocation type is Fixed Amount, a percentage between 0 and 100 when it is Percentage. Ignored for Full.
fields.label: Allocation Amount

fields.description: A zero-dollar test entry has been sent to this account and the bank did not reject it. NACHA gives the receiving bank three banking days to return a prenote; generate_nacha_file will warn about an account still inside that window.
fields.label: Prenote Sent

name: Employee Bank Account
